name: American Eagle (2013 livery)
description: American's 2013 scheme on the American Eagle regional jets: silver all over, the flag fin with its stripes wrapping round the aft fuselage, silver engines; the Flight Symbol and 'American Eagle' in dark charcoal mixed case, below the forward windows.

logos.description: The Flight Symbol ahead of 'American': a red lower wedge and a light-blue upper wedge, both slanting up and aft, split by a white cut (an abstract eagle's head / 'A'). Faces forward on both sides.
A small US flag ahead of the registration on the rear fuselage.

titles.style: American's wordmark with 'Eagle' added in the same letters: upright semibold mixed case in charcoal, below the window line from behind the Flight Symbol, its capitals starting just under the windows.

notes: Measured on the E175 N506SY (left, Feb 2026), checked on the CRJ700 N872DC. On the E175 the title is smaller than the mainline's 'American' and sits below the windows. The small 'Operated by SkyWest' (or the operator's name) under the cockpit is not drawn. Positions are measured on E175s, whose window line is higher (y about 0.3) than the narrow-body average in COORDINATES.md, so titles placed above or below the windows sit higher than they would on a 737. Re-measured 2026-11-16 on the measured E175 (and E170, ERJ-145, CRJ) shapes: the title and Flight Symbol had been placed across the windows (baseline y 0.122, capitals 0.48); photos of the E175 N506SY, CRJ700 N872DC and ERJ-145 N696AE all have them below the window row, the capitals starting just under the windows' bottoms and about 2.4 window heights tall (baseline y -0.20, capitals 0.34 on the E175's windows at y 0.17-0.31), so the base scheme moved, not a per-type entry. Re-checked 2026-11-15: the title's length (x 0.248-0.452 on N506SY, an E175 seen a little from ahead, so within about 0.01) and the wordmark's lowercase height (0.72 of the capitals). No measured E175 shape yet.
history: American Eagle jets took the 2013 scheme with the mainline, with 'Eagle' added to the title.
